cases.title: Renamed agent survives a new run and a client restart
cases.procedure: Rename/customize an agent, run it again, and restart the client.
cases.required_observations: Verify durable identity, saved characteristics, unchanged active-run configuration, and accurate attribution.
cases.blocker: No durable agent-profile authority exists yet; Gate 0 decision 2 (2026-11-26) chose to extend the Theorem backend organization record (ownership map 5 and 7 item 2).
cases.progress: Gate 3: the name is saved on the organization record, so a new run and a client restart read it back; saving bumps the organization revision and leaves roles and models alone. Gate 4: further agents (behind the organization's multiple_agents setting) keep their own profiles, and a turn seated on one speaks with its profile and follows its working preferences. Backend tests cover the record; not run live.

cases.title: Configured provider failure keeps its binding and scoped retrieval
cases.procedure: Fail an explicitly configured provider and exercise concurrent runs/scoped retrieval.
cases.required_observations: Preserve the binding; do not create empty fallback memory or leak another agent's data.
cases.blocker: Needs a live stack with fault injection; the backend behaviour is covered by tests only.
cases.progress: Gate 4 (Theoremrs/Theorem, claude/unified-agent-portability): each agent has a knowledge binding resolved in the DB-03 order (explicit, host-supplied, default). A failed explicit binding is kept and shown, and a turn for that agent is refused with chat_agent_knowledge_unavailable instead of falling back to empty memory. Memory is scoped per agent on writes, lists, recall and export; tests check that an imported agent's memories do not reach the primary.

cases.title: Template and selected memory export/import with lineage
cases.procedure: Export/import a template and selected memory with external payloads.
cases.required_observations: Check lineage, required bindings, missing-object handling, and independence from window geometry.
cases.blocker: Needs a live stack; covered by backend tests and the Agents dialog, not run live.
cases.progress: Gate 4: theorem.agent-package with a content hash, template and selected_memory modes (checkpoint is refused), lineage, role and model requirements and dependencies. Selected memories carry their links as optional dependencies; an import check reports missing bindings before import; an import is always a copy with a new agent id and the source in its lineage; a tampered package is refused. The package holds no window geometry. The UI exports, checks and imports from the Agents dialog.

cases.title: Two provider configurations evaluated from one fixed snapshot
cases.procedure: Evaluate two provider configurations from one fixed snapshot.
cases.required_observations: Verify candidate isolation, recorded differences, and unchanged source-agent memory.
cases.blocker: Needs a live stack; covered by backend tests and the Agents dialog, not run live.
cases.progress: Gate 5: a second, materially different provider (theorem.lexical beside rustyred.embedded) declares its capabilities. An evaluation copies the agent's memories into one fixed snapshot, runs each candidate in its own isolated store, records the differences and the snapshot hash, and checks the source agent's memory and the organization revision are unchanged. The Agents dialog runs it and shows recall and time per candidate.
